hooks.name: API Contract Check
hooks.description: Validates API contracts between FastAPI routes and TypeScript API clients after file saves

action.command:
powershell -NoProfile -Command @"
# Parse input from Kiro
`$input = [System.IO.StreamReader]::new([System.Console]::OpenStandardInput()).ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json
`$filePath = `$input.file.path

# Normalize path separators
`$filePath = `$filePath -replace '\\\\', '/'

Write-Output "=== API Contract Check ==="
Write-Output "File saved: `$filePath"

# CHECK 1: FastAPI route file
if (`$filePath -match '(routes|endpoints).*\.py`$') {
  Write-Output ""
  Write-Output "📋 FASTAPI ROUTE DETECTED"
  Write-Output "Checklist for `$filePath:"
  Write-Output "  ✓ All route functions have docstrings"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Docstrings include HTTP status codes (200, 400, 404, 500, etc.)"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Request body schema documented (request_body annotation)"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Response schema documented (response_model)"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Error responses documented (status_code, responses={})"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Parameters documented (path params, query params, headers)"
  Write-Output ""
  Write-Output "📖 Run: npm run validate:api (if available) to check OpenAPI spec consistency"
}

# CHECK 2: TypeScript API client file
if (`$filePath -match '(api|client).*\.ts`$' -or (`$filePath -match '\.ts`$' -and `$filePath -match 'client')) {
  Write-Output ""
  Write-Output "🔗 TYPESCRIPT API CLIENT DETECTED"
  Write-Output "Checklist for `$filePath:"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Request/response types match backend OpenAPI spec"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Enum values synchronized with backend"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Optional fields match backend (nullable, required)"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Status code handling matches backend error responses"
  Write-Output "  ✓ Error interfaces align with FastAPI error schemas"
  Write-Output ""
  Write-Output "🔄 Run: npm run validate:api or npm run generate:client (if available)"
}

Write-Output ""
Write-Output "ℹ️  Tip: Use OpenAPI spec as source of truth for client generation"
Write-Output ""
exit 0
"@
